allies.rationale_text: Decomposition helps cognitive-load-theory break a problem into logical pieces that working memory can actually manage.
allies.source_quote: Logic trees make it easy to see the structure of the problem. This limits the number of variables the working memory must consider simultaneously.
allies.affinity_rationale: Directly serves CLT's core mechanism — 'Logic trees make it easy to see the structure of the problem. This limits the number of variables the working memory must consider simultaneously' — decomposition IS the structural technique that reduces working memory demand.
allies.activation_condition: When problem complexity is exceeding working memory capacity and decomposition into logical branches is needed to limit the number of variables that must be held simultaneously

allies.rationale_text: Habit-formation frees working memory by automating routine tasks so cognitive effort can shift to the genuinely new challenge.
allies.source_quote: Habits reduce the cognitive load necessary for routine tasks, allowing the conscious mind to conserve effort for higher-level problems.
allies.affinity_rationale: Directly reduces cognitive load — 'Habits reduce the cognitive load necessary for routine tasks, allowing the conscious mind to conserve effort for higher-level problems' — automaticity frees the bottleneck resource for genuinely novel challenges.
allies.activation_condition: When routine procedural tasks are consuming working memory that should be reserved for higher-level analytical challenges, and automation through habit can free that capacity

antagonists.rationale_text: Curse-of-knowledge undermines cognitive-load-theory by causing experts to communicate at their own level of abstraction, directly increasing the novice's cognitive load instead of reducing it.
antagonists.source_quote: The innate tendency of experts to communicate complexity, directly increasing the novice's cognitive load.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Directly increases the load CLT manages — 'The innate tendency of experts to communicate complexity, directly increasing the novice's cognitive load' — experts communicate at their own abstraction level, imposing unnecessary extrinsic load.
antagonists.activation_condition: When expert communication is adding unnecessary complexity that increases the audience's cognitive load because the expert has forgotten what it is like not to know the material

structured_tensions.tension_text: Cognitive-load-theory conflicts with first-principles-thinking when deep decomposition overloads working memory before the core abstraction is stable.
structured_tensions.source_quote: cognitive-load-theory vs first-principles-thinking: cognitive-load-theory conflicts with first-principles-thinking (first principles thinking) when deep decomposition overloads working memory before core abstractions stabilize.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Cognitive-load-theory conflicts with optionality when too many parallel branches exceed practical decision bandwidth.
structured_tensions.source_quote: cognitive-load-theory vs optionality: cognitive-load-theory conflicts with optionality (optionality) when too many parallel branches exceed practical decision bandwidth.
